pet_notes: Compact stylized 3D-toy monkey king familiar grounded solely in the reference: warm golden-brown fur with a creamy muzzle, chest, and belly; very large glossy amber-gold eyes with dark lashes and arched expressive brows; playful earned arrogance and a knowing asymmetric smile; spiky flame-like golden hair and round pink ears; gold circlet with two spiral curls; red neck scarf and flowing red waist sash; engraved gold wrist cuffs; curled golden tail; ornate long gold staff held casually across the shoulders or in a paw; small opaque curled white cloud platform physically touching the feet. Preserve the readable face, proud compact silhouette, gold/red palette, and staff-tail-cloud triad at 60px; remove the reference scene, glow, floor lighting, and all detached effects.
style_notes: Grounded compact transparent pet production art: no scenery, text, glow, shadows, particles, motion lines, or opaque background; clean removable chroma background only.
